source_policy: Primary evidence and official documentation only. Descriptions are limited paraphrases; cited facts do not establish buyer demand or campaign performance.

sources.title: Queued Up: 2026 Edition
sources.publisher: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and GridTracker
facts_used: Median request-to-operation time exceeded five years for projects completed in 2025 where data were available
Data coverage is transmission generation/storage requests, not load, distribution or behind-the-meter requests
sources.limitation: Queue delay does not identify numerical study runtime as causal bottleneck. No buyer-level demand or profitability.

sources.title: Distributed Energy Resource Interconnection Roadmap
facts_used: Roadmap identifies data access, study automation, coordination and model validation
sources.limitation: Policy roadmap, not evaluation of this instrument or willingness to pay; distribution scope differs from transmission benchmark.

sources.title: Contingencies
facts_used: Security-constrained linear OPF and BODF are established capabilities
Bridge outages make BODF singular and require separate treatment
sources.limitation: Documented method availability is not source-matched local execution of PyPSA; only branch outages are considered by the described formulation.

sources.title: PGLib-OPF v23.07
sources.publisher: IEEE PES Task Force on Benchmarks for Validation of Emerging Power System Algorithms
facts_used: Curated AC OPF benchmarks in MATPOWER format
Reference implementations MATPOWER and PowerModels are identified by maintainers
sources.rights: Case data CC BY 4.0; preserve original per-file copyright and attribution. Repository software MIT, distinct from data license.
sources.limitation: Historical public benchmarks are not real customer interconnection models, market transactions or independent fresh field cases.

sources.title: Battery Second-Use Reconditioning Based on Sparse Data and Models
sources.publisher: National Laboratory of the Rockies repository; original NREL report NREL/TP-5700-93187
facts_used: NREL and Smartville work targets rapid state-of-health characterization and second-use lifetime forecasting
sources.limitation: Abstract-level evidence of competent predecessor, not reproduced performance or transferable safety validation.

sources.title: Immediate remaining capacity estimation of heterogeneous second-life lithium-ion batteries via deep generative transfer learning
sources.publisher: Energy & Environmental Science; original research authors
facts_used: Published abstract describes synthetic voltage generation and domain alignment for heterogeneous second-life capacity estimation
sources.limitation: Full canonical publisher page returned HTTP 403. Abstract/search evidence only; no performance number adopted and no reproduction claimed.

sources.title: Li-ion Battery Aging Datasets
sources.publisher: NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence / NASA Open Data Portal
facts_used: Catalog describes charge/discharge/EIS aging records with voltage, current, temperature and capacity
Retrieved catalog says no attached data resources
sources.limitation: Availability gap at this endpoint is not a claim no mirror exists. Laboratory cell aging is not a heterogeneous retired-pack safety/economic cohort.

sources.title: Low-Temperature, Efficient Heat Capture to Reduce Natural Gas Consumption in the Industrial Sector
sources.publisher: California Energy Commission; Element 16 Technologies final project report
facts_used: Site demonstration recovers low-pressure steam and reports measured gas-use reduction
sources.limitation: Project-specific result is not universal recovery efficiency, payback, profitability or access to this site's operating traces.

sources.title: Demonstrating Replicable, Innovative, Large-Scale Heat Recovery in the Industrial Sector
sources.publisher: California Energy Commission; original project report authors
facts_used: Polymer heat-exchanger technology tested in laboratory and installed industrial demonstrations
sources.limitation: No generic cost reduction, market-size estimate or assumed efficiency is used as a calibration for our missing cohort.

sources.title: Final Report: Industrial Excess Heat
sources.publisher: IEA Industrial Energy-Related Technologies and Systems TCP
facts_used: Synthesis maps about fifty projects and covers process integration and industrial symbiosis
sources.limitation: Synthesis establishes active predecessor work; it does not validate a new site or this campaign's commercial forecast.

sources.title: makeBdc reference and original implementation
facts_used: DC branch coefficients include off-nominal tap ratio and phase-shift injection terms
sources.limitation: Equation provenance only; no utility service acceptance or operational qualification
